facts.text: Maria volunteered at a shelter during an event for kids last week.

evidence.quote: Last week I volunteered at a shelter during an event for kids, and it's been a great experience.

facts.text: Maria's aunt used to help her family out when they were struggling, which inspired her to volunteer.

evidence.quote: My aunt believed in volunteering, and used to help my family out when we were struggling, so I'm inspired by her.

facts.text: Maria had a meaningful interaction with an 8-year-old girl who had no other family during her volunteer work.

evidence.quote: It was when I noticed a little girl around 8 sitting all alone. She seemed so sad. So, I sat with her and we talked. Turns out she had no other family - it broke my heart.
